headline: Total traffic falls -5.4% in rain — why?
evidence: Motorcycles plunge -21.0% (-30.5% in rush hours) across 293 wet camera-hours, hiding a modal shift to cars.

headline: Localized rain shifts travel from 2-wheelers to 4-wheelers
evidence: In 15 hours comparing wet vs dry cameras <=3km apart (172 pairs), cars jump +12.6 percentage points.

headline: Footbridge sheltering & station proximity do not explain congestion
evidence: Stationary bikes near shelters changed 2.5% dry vs 2.8% wet (sidewalk parking); only 20% of denser cams sit near rail.

headline: Rain is the #1 weather feature for motorcycle prediction
evidence: HistGradientBoosting reaches R2=0.83 (total) & 0.75 (moto); BMA 07:00 drop proved to be 1.4 KB white feed outage frames.

headline: Turn rain radar into transit feeder & fleet dispatch alerts
evidence: Pre-position 4-wheel ride-hailing + BTS/MRT feeder shuttles on high rail-density corridors before peak 16:00-20:00 rain.
